name: 三色歌舞电影
palette: 宝石红、钴蓝、祖母绿、金黄与奶油白，高饱和但肤色保持自然层次
lighting: 棚拍硬主光、轮廓背光与可见舞台光区，服装和布景色彩分离清楚
optics: 经典球面镜头、轻柔扩散与稳定深焦，保留染印电影般浓郁而洁净的色彩
composition: 正面轴线、几何群舞、完整肢体动作和多层舞台纵深，布景成为叙事的一部分
camera_motion: graceful crane rise, lateral ensemble track, measured dolly, choreography-led reframing
style_instructions: Classic three-strip Technicolor musical cinema, jewel-toned studio sets, elegant ensemble choreography, theatrical production design and radiant analog color separation.
avoid_instructions: No modern music-video neon, no fashion-editorial solo pose, no muted naturalism, no clipped limbs, no text or watermark.
